notes.title: FSE - Patch 2.4
notes.content:
Hello.

First I wanted to thank everyone that's been writing nice things about the game and reporting bugs. Thank you. It means a lot to me.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32384014/8d33b9380b6b694cbb43ca07f46ca350dc339c24.png[/img]

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 2.4:

- Fixed the bugs that occured in some of the dialogue choices between Noah and Kottis, that could freeze the game.
- Some text fixes.
